newsitem.title: CHINA: China steel plant sets expansion, mulls shr offer.
newsitem.headline: China steel plant sets expansion, mulls shr offer.

text.p: Laiwu Iron and Steel General Works in China's eastern province of Shandong said on Thursday it has launched an 888.21 million yuan ($107 million) expansion project to be financed by offers of stock and bonds.
"The expansion project has already begun," the official said by telephone from the factory's headquarters in Laiwu.
Laiwu Steel plans to issue 80 millon A shares for domestic investors in the second quarter, he said without giving details of how much money that would raise.
He did not say whether the company had received regulatory approval for the offers.
The plant would also issue 50 million yuan worth of bonds and has already received a 20-year loan of about $40 millon from the Asian Development Bank. He did not give further details.
The expansion project, expected be completed in 1999, would add annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes of steel products, the official said.
The company is expected to produce 1.6 million tonnes of steel and 1.3 million tonnes of steel products in 1997.
